summary:
• Claude Code Code Mode — an experimental mode that emits runnable JavaScript tied to version‑gated plugins, cutting debugging time for AI‑augmented IDEs.
• Gemini 4 Hydrogen — Google’s low‑cost tier of the Gemini 4 family, delivering faster, token‑efficient responses for high‑volume, routine coding tasks.
• Agentic Hacking Skills — a GitHub collection of AI‑driven web security agents and skill templates that auto‑install and run, enabling one‑command vulnerability automation.
• WebsiteBench — an open‑source benchmark that asks agents to reverse‑engineer live sites into full‑stack replicas, using thousands of hidden functional and visual checks to gauge readiness.
• Muse phone‑call feature — Meta’s consumer AI now places calls to U.S. businesses for subscribers, extending assistance to voice interactions and saving user time.
• AWS Emulator — a local drop‑in replacement for AWS APIs that lets developers and CI pipelines run S3, DynamoDB, Lambda mocks offline, avoiding cloud charges.
